ApiError.description: A structured error: a stable code, a human hint, and typed details.

hint.description: For humans; may change between releases.

Code.description: A stable machine error code. `lower_snake`; the HTTP status comes from [`Code::status`].

oneOf.description: 400: the request is malformed.
400: a field failed validation; `details.field` names it.
401: no or unknown credentials.
401: the session expired.
403: a permission bit is missing.
403: an org policy forbids this.
403: a valid pass for a principal with no Sew account.
403: act-as targeted a person; only agents can be acted as.
403: the command is off on a K2-provided install.
403: a quota or count limit is reached.
404: missing, or hidden from the caller (masked).
405: only GET reads and POST mutations exist.
409: conflicts with current state.
409: an `Idempotency-Key` was reused with a different body.
410: the cursor is behind the change-log floor; `details.floor` says where.
413: the body or a field is too large.
422: valid request, but the target's state forbids it.
429: rate limited; `details.retry_after_ms` says when to retry.
500: a server bug.
503: temporarily unavailable.
416: the byte range is outside the file; `Content-Range: bytes */<size>`.
507: the server's file storage is below its free-space floor.

410: the meeting has ended or was cancelled (also a voice join in its
channel).

425: too early: the meeting opens at `details.opens_at` (also a voice join
before `starts_at` − 15 min).

404: a meeting link that is unknown, has a wrong secret, was revoked or rotated, or
whose meeting ended or was cancelled (one body for all four).
423: the meeting is locked.

429: the meeting's lobby or room is full (`max_waiting`, `max_guests_inside`;
nothing was written).

403: this join nonce (or member) was turned away twice within 10 minutes and may
not knock on this meeting for an hour.

410: the feed's cursor is behind the pruned part of the log (the person
notification feed); `details.oldest_seq` says where to resume.

MgmtMemberChannelsItemResult.description:
One item's answer in a bulk sync: `answer` on success, `error` (the error body a single
sync would answer) otherwise.

status.description: The HTTP status the single sync would answer (`200`, `409`, `422`, …).

MgmtMemberChannelsResponse.description: Answer of one sync item. Channel lists are ascending.

items.description: A Sew id: a decimal string of a 64-bit time-sortable id (1 to 9223372036854775807).

level.description: The person's level after the sync (absent when `skipped`).

queued.description:
The item has more than 1,000 channel changes and runs as a job: `added`, `removed`
and `unchanged` are empty, `job_id` names the job (`GET /mgmt/v1/jobs/{id}`). A later
sync of the same person replaces a job that has not run.

items.description: A Sew id: a decimal string of a 64-bit time-sortable id (1 to 9223372036854775807).

skipped.description: Set when the item changed nothing for its person, with why.

unchanged.description: Listed channels the person was in already.

items.description: A Sew id: a decimal string of a 64-bit time-sortable id (1 to 9223372036854775807).

unknown_channel_ids.description:
Listed ids that are not live private channels of this Space (unknown, in another
Space, archived, public or a meeting's channel); the rest of the list applied.

items.description: A Sew id: a decimal string of a 64-bit time-sortable id (1 to 9223372036854775807).

MgmtMemberChannelsSkip.description: Why a sync item changed nothing for its person.

oneOf.description:
The person is the Space's owner (the App's service owner): the sync never removes,
demotes or replaces the owner, who is in every channel.
The person was deprovisioned; only `principals/provision` brings them back.
The Space bans the person; bans win over the sync.
The Space is at its App's `members_per_space_max`, so the person could not join.

SpaceLevel.description:
A person's level in an App-governed Space (K2's sync sets it), and an App's
`max_level`. `moderator` and `admin` are the Space's managed roles; `member` is
`@everyone`.

oneOf.description: `@everyone` only.
The managed Moderator role.
The managed Admin role (the Moderator bits plus MENTION_EVERYONE).
